blurb: Capital of the Yuan, Ming and Qing, and of China today.

facts.t: Kublai Khan built a new capital, Dadu, here from 1267. Marco Polo described its walls and its paper money. Ming Beijing was built on top of it.
The emperors came here each winter solstice to pray for good harvests. The round Hall of Prayer stands on a square yard, for a round heaven over a square earth.
The most visited stretch of the Great Wall, about 70 km north-west of the city, was built by the Ming in 1505. Earlier walls on other lines go back to Qin Shi Huang and before.
